notes.title: Tournament Practice Server Shutdown Notice
notes.content: [p]Dear Challengers,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continuous support and companionship with 《G9: League of Aces》. We would like to inform you that the tournament practice server will officially cease operations starting at 10:00 AM (Taiwan Time) on Tuesday, August 5, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]We understand how eagerly everyone is anticipating the official launch of the game. Our team is currently working at full speed to finalize preparations for the official version, striving to deliver an even more polished gaming experience for all of you. This temporary farewell is only for a better reunion—we look forward to seeing you again on the battlefield when the game officially launches, fighting side by side![/p][p] [/p][p]Sincerely, The 《G9: League of Aces》 Operations Team[/p]

notes.title: 《G9:League of Aces》Official Server Shutdown Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946800/ce2802a9daa10d15bedb8e2ae3d676a7018ecc6a.png[/img]

Dear Challengers,

The official server of G9: League of Aces is scheduled for a shutdown on Monday, May 26, 2025, which will not affect gameplay on the tournament practice server. Challengers currently on the official server are kindly requested to switch to the tournament practice server for continued play. Please refer to the guided instructions below for details on how to access it.

Additionally, after the official server shutdown, G9: League of Aces will undergo adjustments and modifications, and it will reopen in the future. We look forward to reuniting with you all and playing together again soon!

[Official Server Shutdown Notice]

Maintenance Time: Monday, May 26, 2025, at 10:00
Impact Scope: Official server will be closed; the tournament practice server will remain unaffected.

[Guided Instructions for Accessing the Tournament Practice Server]

notes.title: 《G9:League of Aces 特攻聯盟》遊戲例行維護公告
notes.content:
親愛的挑戰者們，遊戲預計將於[h2][b]8/29 10:00-14:00[/b][/h2]進行例行維護更新，
請玩家提前下線離開遊戲，造成不便，還請見諒。

【更新內容】明細如下：

1. 英雄技能調整

【艾維斯】
Q1、Q2、R→傷害上調。
W1→傷害、[緩速]效果下調。
E2→[無敵]效果沒有觸發修正。

【邦妮】
Q1、Q2、R→傷害上調。

【多莉安】
Q1、Q2、W2、E1→傷害上調。

【蒂芬妮】
Q1、Q2、W2、R→傷害上調。

【艾娃】
Q1、Q2、W1、W2、R→傷害上調。
Q1→殘留球體引爆時間縮短3秒→2秒。
技能icon更新。

2. 調整戰場守衛放置機制，偵查守衛、掃描守衛可同時存時在場上。

3. 配隊等待時間若超過90秒，系統會自動加入Bot對手。

4. 自訂對戰改為等級1、練習戰改為等級2就可以進行。

5. 修正UI開啟後左上方"大廳"，按鈕點擊無反應之問題。


《G9: League of Aces 特攻聯盟》營運團隊 敬上

notes.title: 《G9:League of Aces 特攻聯盟》搶先體驗刪檔測試開服公告
notes.content:
親愛的挑戰者們，歡迎進入《G9:League of Aces 特攻聯盟》的未來科幻世界，
在這裡您將會化身身懷絕技、造型迥異的未來戰士們，並與四面八方的挑戰者們，
進行對戰一較高下，體驗最刺激熱血的競技戰場。

搶先體驗版本，將先開放13隻英雄，一進入遊戲可以直接在任務面板領取首隻英雄希爾達(射手)，隨玩家等級的提升，可再獲得下列英雄：
●等級3:亞特伍德(坦克)
●等級5:烏黎卡(戰士)
●等級7:多莉安(刺客法師)
●等級9:邦妮(法師輔助)
●等級11:蘭斯(刺客)

遊戲開放以下內容：
玩家對戰：5V5對戰、ARAM、瘋狂樂園，體驗最經典的5V5對戰及不同地圖的玩法樂趣挑戰，
或是透過練習戰及自訂模式熟悉英雄特色、道具搭配使用，
系統功能則開放任務、背包、商店、個人資訊、聊天等基本功能。
玩家在對戰、任務、郵件獎勵等方式獲得的遊戲金幣，
可在背包中使用兌換其他的英雄角色。

目前版本暫不開放儲值及商店功能，請待後續版本更新開放時，會另做公告詳細說明。

《G9:League of Aces 特攻聯盟》預計在Q3時會推出手機版本並進行CB測試，
在CB測試結束時，STEAM搶先體驗也會暫告結束，手機及STEAM的帳號及遊戲資料都會進行刪除。

開服注意事項：
1. 對戰配對時，請耐心等待其他玩家加入，對戰時請配合團隊其他隊友，保持理性溝通，
制定策略，協同(伴侶、家人、朋友)攻守，將會是遊戲致勝的關鍵。
2. 建議電腦配備：
作業系統：Win10 64位元
處理器：Quad Core 3.0GHz以上
記憶體: 16 GB 記憶體
顯示卡: Nvidia GTX 1060/AMD Radeon™ RX 550以上
網路: 寬頻網際網路連線
儲存空間: 6 GB 以上的可用硬碟空間
3. 部分筆電跟遊戲兼容性不匹配，若挑戰者登入遊戲發生問題，請聯繫遊戲客服信箱：cs@interserv.com.tw，並提供設備及防毒軟體資訊，協助運營團隊排查問題。

感謝您對《G9: League of Aces 特攻聯盟》的支持與期待，
若有任何遊戲問題建議，可寄信到cs@interserv.com.tw
官方粉絲團、Discord也歡迎留言及討論！

《G9:League of Aces 特攻聯盟》營運團隊 敬上

notes.title: "G9: League of Aces" is holding a closed beta test. (4/1～5/4)
notes.content:
Presenting the limited-time closed beta version of "G9: League of Aces," the first multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game developed by Gods Flame Digital and published by InterServ International on the Steam platform.

"G9: League of Aces" is a futuristic MOBA game where heroes possess personalized skill systems, allowing players to freely choose skill combinations according to their preferences on the competitive battlefield of G9. The game features three competitive modes: 5v5, A.R.A.M., and a unique Crazy Carnival mode, each with its own distinctive features. Whether it's high-tech enhanced champion, mutant, superhumans, or extraterrestrials, all can showcase their abilities on this battlefield and vie for ultimate glory.

New champions revealed in advance:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946800/db508df8b339966200da4649d9fa9919d226d867.jpg[/img]
Jocky:
Jocky is a melee character who uses lightning-based tactical skills. With high-pressure stacking, he can generate shields and utilize electromagnetic forces to complement his skills.

Sandy:
Sandy excels in using water energy and can reduce enemy magic defenses. In controlled scenarios, she can continuously unleash the fierce water currents of "Surging Waves," capable of shaking the entire field with floods.

Tom:
Tom specializes in using a whip, inflicting area damage on enemies and restoring his own maximum health through different whip techniques. He can also execute "Lightning Five-Lash," causing sustained and slowing damage to enemies, in addition to stunning them with whip strikes.

There are currently over 30 super-powered heroes in the game, with ongoing expansions. Players are invited to participate in this test to experience the battle frenzy of the futuristic century.
